name: Faster Step 1 resize · linear interpolation
hypothesis: Keep v001 preprocessing unchanged except test OpenCV linear interpolation instead of area interpolation when downscaling the raw photo to the Step 1 448 × 448 input. This may reduce resize latency; the altered segmentation input must be checked for quality.
changes: Use cv2.INTER_LINEAR for Step 1 input resizing when downscaling; retain exact linear interpolation when not downscaling.

quality_policy.gate: same cohort, no failures, and no MAE, RMSE, or per-photo absolute-error regression; microbatch smoke results are not a quality conclusion
